one: Treking to the Páramo de Ocetá with Espeletia Trips was one of the best decisions of my life. The organization was impeccable from the very beginning. The guides not only know the route perfectly, but they also teach you to respect and understand the importance of the frailejones (Espeletia plants). The travel insurance gave me great peace of mind!
two: As a nature photographer, I was looking for an agency committed to the environment, and their Cortolima Green Seal certification convinced me. The landscape is otherworldly. The team was patient with my timing for taking photos, and the transportation was super comfortable. I recommend this trip 100%.
three: We went with our teenage children, and although the ascent was a bit physically demanding, the guides helped us maintain an excellent pace for everyone. The agency's preparation and warmth are evident. The typical mountain lunch at the end of the trek was the perfect ending.
